Normal: The battery has aged noticeably (60–80% of design capacity). Expect shorter runtimes; plan for a replacement within a year or two.
To slow further wear: avoid keeping it at 100% on AC constantly (many vendors offer an 80% charge-limit setting) and avoid heat.
Bad: Battery capacity is below 60% of design — replacement territory.
IMPORTANT: if the battery or case shows ANY swelling, stop using and charging the device immediately and have the battery replaced — swollen batteries are a fire hazard.

rules.forecast: Capacity loss accelerates with heat and full-charge storage; at the current wear level, runtimes will keep shrinking noticeably each year.
